d:
Gold Rush reaches a breaking point as five weeks without pay leave Todd Hoffman's crew turning against each other. Meanwhile, Parker Schnabel pays the price for running his washplant without protection from rocks, while Tony Beets takes on a massive trailer project to move his barge, only to discover his measurements are wrong. With tensions rising and costly mistakes piling up, can the miners get their operations back on track?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 11, on Discovery Channel India.
